ycy npm open package-settings
Open npm package settings from the current project or workspace
Usage:
  ycy npm open package-settings [flags]
Flags:
  --batch	Open all listed packages without prompting
  -h, --help	help for package-settings
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
Examples:
ycy npm open package-settings
ycy npm open package-settings --batch
